rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Lead with discipline, not failure mode
rules_evaluated.evidence: No `## Big Idea` / Key Concepts / What-You'll-Learn heading for the rule's named targets. Checked the page's de-facto thesis anyway: opens 'Use fewer words, pay a smaller bill. That framing is mostly wrong' → 'the real story is about quality' → 'not thrift... it is signal-to-noise' — leads with the positive discipline (signal-to-noise, smallest high-signal set) as the resolution, failure word (thrift) is the case being corrected, not the title. Section headers throughout are verb-led disciplines (Start clean, Pass paths not paste, Use a subagent as a firewall, Route by complexity not price, Keep what you carry lean), not failure words.

Lines 59-61 ('Compaction is always lossy, so always hand off... That reversal is the real lesson of this whole topic... check it against your own /context before you trust it') retell the Amp compaction/handoff-reversal story via the same source pair (ampcode.com/news/handoff + /news/neo) that the strategy doc reserves for M5's closing lecture (lectures/what-packaging-is.md; strategy doc line 387, verified verbatim): 'frames context-for-long-runs as a five-camp divergence... names the Sourcegraph Amp counter-camp.' Different purpose here (general epistemic caution — 'advice has a shelf life' — vs. M5's technique-choice teaching among five camps) and the story sits in this file's own vetted Sources list, so it reads as legitimate parallel use of the same source rather than a clear front-run — but the supplementary has no module-side entry point yet (maintainer block: 'Still owed before first cohort: a module-side entry point... candidate home: an if-time-allows callout in an M2/M3 module') and already renders unlocked on the SPA supplementaries index, so a student could read this story well before reaching M5's reveal. Everything else under this rule checks out clean: the subagent-as-firewall paragraph mirrors M1's already-sanctioned pre-exposure ('subagent map-reduce' carried in M1 homework via the Cherny talk, strategy doc line 288) rather than front-running M3's 'first subagent' concentration (line 284); the load-bearing memory-vs-context terminology gate (§ Terminology, 144-153) is honored precisely throughout — CLAUDE.md is consistently described as the file that 'loads at the top of each window,' never as something whose 'context compounds'; and the Ramp anchor's 'cost-posture (leverage over tokens)' cultural frame (line 611) matches this file's own cost-is-a-side-effect-of-quality reframe. Separately (not a sequencing violation, noted for hygiene): strategy doc § Supplementary material (planned), 586-596, still lists only 5 planned supplementaries and doesn't carry this already-shipped 6th one — a documentation-inventory gap under curriculum/CLAUDE.md's 'Strategy and module file change in the same edit; drift = process bug' rule, not itself a rule-4 finding.
